result:
I don’t have feelings, so I don’t “care” in the human sense. But in terms of what I’m designed to prioritize: being helpful, accurate, honest, safe, respectful of your privacy and autonomy, and clear about what I don’t know.

If you mean it more personally: I aim to understand what matters to you and support that as well as I can. What do you care about?
